title: Shared types, policy constants and date key helpers

task.description: Create src/lib/types.ts with the SPEC types only (no runtime code): UserType, UserSettings, RideLog, MonthSnapshot, MonthMeta, MonthIndex, RiskResult, PassComparison, StoreResult, SaveResult and RouteState/InsightRouteState. Also create the kpassPolicy.ts constants and the local-time dateKeys.ts pure functions.
acceptance_criteria: types.ts contains 0 occurrences of 'export const' and 0 of 'function'. StoreResult reason is exactly 'NO_SETTINGS'|'INVALID_DATE'|'DAILY_MAX'|'BELOW_ZERO'|'QUOTA'
cutoffMonth(2026-09-22)==='2025-09'. isValidRecordDate returns true for '2026-09-22' and '2025-09-01', and false for '2026-09-23', '2025-08-31' and '2026-02-30'
At local time 2026-09-22 00:30, toDateKey returns '2026-09-22'. formatDayLabel('2026-09-22')==='9월 22일 (화)'

task.description: Implement loadSettings, loadRides, loadMonthMeta and buildMonthIndex in src/lib/storage/loaders.ts. Loaders only read via try/JSON.parse, validate against the SPEC CHECK rules, and treat corrupt data as null or empty. They never call setItem, removeItem or console.error. A snapshot's id is overwritten with its months map key.
acceptance_criteria: After corrupt JSON is stored under 'kpass:settings', loadSettings() returns null, the raw localStorage value is unchanged, and setItem is called 0 times
When a months['2026-08'] snapshot has id 'x', loadMonthMeta() returns that snapshot with id==='2026-08'
buildMonthIndex('abc') returns {byMonth:{},monthsDesc:[]}. buildMonthIndex({'2026-09-01':2,'2026-08-03':1}).monthsDesc equals ['2026-09','2026-08']

title: Storage writes: writePair, saveSettings, setDayCount, today ±1, kpassStore barrel

task.description: In src/lib/storage/writes.ts, implement writePair (two-key write with rollback), saveSettings, setDayCount, incrementToday and decrementToday. Checks run in order: NO_SETTINGS → INVALID_DATE → DAILY_MAX/BELOW_ZERO, and QUOTA triggers a rollback. Writes clean up entries older than 13 months, and writing to a past month creates no snapshot. kpassStore.ts re-exports loaders and writes.
acceptance_criteria: Without settings, incrementToday() returns {ok:false,reason:'NO_SETTINGS'} and 'kpass:rides' stays absent
With today at 20 rides, incrementToday() returns DAILY_MAX. With today at 0, decrementToday() returns BELOW_ZERO. setDayCount('2026-09-23') returns INVALID_DATE
When setItem is mocked to throw QuotaExceededError on the second key, the result is QUOTA and both 'kpass:rides' and 'kpass:monthMeta' match their pre-write raw values
After a write, day keys earlier than '2025-09' are deleted. setDayCount('2026-08-10',3) leaves months['2026-08'] unchanged

db_schema: writePair(kpass:rides, kpass:monthMeta) with rollback; RideLog.days value 0 → key deleted

task.description: src/hooks/kpass.tsx provides KpassProvider (context) plus useSettings, useRides and useMonthMeta. State is read synchronously from localStorage at mount. Memory state is updated only after a write returns ok. useRides derives MonthIndex with useMemo(buildMonthIndex(days)). On a visibilitychange to visible, state is reloaded.
acceptance_criteria: With renderHook, after useRides().increment() returns ok, todayCount rises by 1 and monthIndex.byMonth['2026-09'] rises by 1
When setItem is mocked to throw QUOTA, todayCount after increment() is unchanged and the returned reason is 'QUOTA'
After the storage value is changed externally and a visibilitychange (visible) event is dispatched, the hook value reflects the new storage value

title: Calculation service ①: refund, net cost and break-even

task.description: Put isValidCount/isValidPositive/isValidType in src/lib/calc/guards.ts. Implement calcRefund, calcKpassNetCost and calcBreakEven in src/lib/calc/refund.ts. Formula: floor(min(rides,60)×fare×rate/10)×10. Invalid input returns 0 or null and never throws. Constants come only from kpassPolicy.ts.
acceptance_criteria: calcBreakEven(1500,'general',55000)=46 and calcBreakEven(1500,'general',500000)=null
NaN, Infinity, negative, string and bad type inputs make calcRefund/calcKpassNetCost return 0 and calcBreakEven return null, with 0 exceptions

title: Calculation service ②: projection, risk, pass comparison and kpassCalc barrel

task.description: src/lib/calc/risk.ts implements calcProjection, calcRisk (order: achieved → danger → not_started → on_track → warning), comparePass and calcInsightInitialRides=min(max(projection,count),120). src/lib/kpassCalc.ts re-exports refund and risk. Screens import only from kpassCalc.
acceptance_criteria: calcRisk(14, 2026-09-22) returns {status:'warning',projection:19,remaining:7,remainingDays:9}. calcRisk(0, 09-29) returns {danger,0,21,2}. calcRisk(0, 09-20) returns not_started. calcRisk(NaN, 09-22) returns {danger,0,21,9}
comparePass returns {kpassNetCost:0,passPrice:0,winner:'even',diff:0} when passPrice is null or NaN
calcInsightInitialRides returns: (10, 09-01)=120, (130, 09-22)=120, (14, 09-22)=19

title: Copy service: kpassCopy (display text and amount format)

task.description: src/lib/kpassCopy.ts turns the SPEC copy tables into pure functions: formatWon, riskCopy (5 risk-card rows), refundCopy (3 rows, computed only through calcRefund), typeRateLabel and verdictCopy (S4 verdict text). Pages never build copy themselves; they only call these functions.
acceptance_criteria: riskCopy for (14 rides, 09-22) returns line1 '지금 속도면 19회로 2회 모자라요', line2 '남은 9일 동안 7회 더 타야 해요' and badge '주의'
refundCopy(14,1500,'general').sub==='21회까지 7회 남았어요 · 달성하면 예상 6,300원부터 받아요'. refundCopy(0,…).sub==='21회를 채우면 환급이 시작돼요'. refundCopy(22,…).amount==='6,600원'
typeRateLabel('general')==='일반 20%'. verdictCopy text and badge for kpass/pass/even match the SPEC S4 table character for character

It handles type selection, validates avg fare (100–10,000) and pass price (empty=null, 1,000–500,000), and calls saveSettings. Onboarding success → navigate('/',{replace:true}). Settings success → Toast then navigate(-1). On QUOTA, show a Toast and do not navigate.

When fare 50 is submitted, help text '100원에서 10,000원 사이로 입력해주세요' appears and 'kpass:settings' is not stored
